svg.aria-label: Inside Express: on /io the event loop sets a timer and moves on; on /cpu it is stuck computing fib(40) while every request waits; on /cpu-parallel it hands fib to worker threads on other cores and stays free.
svg.title: Inside Express: on /io the event loop sets a timer and moves on; on /cpu it is stuck computing fib(40) while every request waits; on /cpu-parallel it hands fib to worker threads on other cores and stays free.
svg.text: Inside Express: one JavaScript thread does everything
Node runs your JS on a single thread, the event loop. Here is what happens to it on each route.
one at a time, server frozen
